text: The LORD Loves the Gates of Zion

segments.text: He has founded His city on the holy mountains.

footnotes.text: + Literally His foundation is on the holy mountains

segments.text: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah
I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me— along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush — when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Rahab is a poetic name for Egypt.
+ That is, the upper Nile region

segments.text: And it will be said of Zion:
This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples:
This one was born in Zion.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: All my springs of joy are in You.
segments.speaker: Singers and pipers
